supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failed logons for svc-claimsync occurred on FILE-HD-01 from 13:35:56 through 13:50:53 UTC, at roughly one-minute intervals. The 4625 events report bad-password status 0xc000006a.
The failures identify FILE-HD-01 as the workstation and show source address 10.30.20.20; the FILE-HD-01 events consistently name lsass.exe as the recorded process.
Domain-controller records corroborate failed credential validation: 4776 events report status 0xc000006a, and 4771 events report status 0x18 for svc-claimsync from 10.30.20.20.

The pattern is consistent with the supplied context that svc-claimsync runs and re-authenticates on FILE-HD-01 every minute, following its scheduled 13:30 UTC password rotation that requires a manual job update. This supports a stale-credential explanation rather than establishing malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records cover only 13:35:56–13:50:53 UTC, not the full requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The 4625 process field identifies lsass.exe, but these records do not identify the application or scheduled task that supplied the credentials.
The evidence contains authentication failures but does not include password-change, job-configuration, task-execution, or broader host-activity records.
claims_not_established: Whether the password rotation actually completed at 13:30 UTC or when the ClaimSync job configuration was updated.
Whether the failed attempts stopped or were followed by successful authentication after 13:50:53 UTC.
Whether any unrelated malicious activity occurred outside the supplied authentication records.
additional_evidence_needed: For operational confirmation, verify the password-rotation audit record and the ClaimSync job update on FILE-HD-01; investigate further if the failures continued after the job was updated.
